question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Partial or total loss of memory
solution:
The correct answer is "Amnesia."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Amnesia"** refers to a condition characterized by the partial or complete loss of memory. (याद्‌दाश्‍त खो बैठने की अवस्‍था; स्‍मृति-लोप)
 
• This loss of memory can be temporary or permanent and may affect various aspects of a person's life, including their personal experiences, identity, and knowledge.
 
• So, a partial or total loss of memory is called **"Amnesia."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ascetic: **not allowing yourself physical pleasures, especially for religious reasons. (विशेषतः धार्मिक कारणों से भौतिक सुखों से विमुख)
 
• **Atheist: **a person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods. (नास्तिक, निरीश्‍वरवादी)
 
• **Axiom: **a rule or principle that most people believe to be true. (सब से स्‍वीकृत सिद्घांत या नियम; स्‍वयं-सिद्घ कथन)
